doc1.Title: CO oxidation on Pt/CeO2(111)
doc1.Text: Pt was deposited on CeO2(111) with a loading of 1 wt% and reduced under H2 at 300 C for 2 h. CO oxidation was carried out in 1% CO and 10% O2 with N2 balance at 150 C. The catalyst showed 95% conversion and 100% selectivity to CO2.

doc2.Title: Methanol adsorption on TiO2(110)
doc2.Abstract: Methanol adsorption on rutile TiO2(110) was studied under UHV. Oxygen vacancies acted as active sites and methoxy was identified as an intermediate.
